NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 10 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 10, 10:42 AM ET

George Pickens is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 10 DraftKings main slate at 17.6 DraftKings points for $6,300, against San Francisco. Christian Watson (15.0, $7,700) and Chris Olave (12.4, $7,000) are next.

Josh Cameron returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 3.03 projected points per $1,000 at $3,300.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 10, 10:42 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 10

George Pickens, DAL vs SF ($6,300)

George Pickens carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 17.6 DraftKings points at $6,300. That is 2.6 points clear of Christian Watson. The model gives him 9.2 targets on 35.7 routes. The salary works out to 2.79 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 13 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Pickens averaged 17.6 points with a simulated floor of 5.1 and a ceiling of 42.2, and he holds 33% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 4.5-point underdog at home against San Francisco, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 55.5.

Christian Watson, GB vs MIN ($7,700)

Christian Watson projects 2nd at the position with 15.0 DraftKings points at $7,700. The model gives him 7.3 targets on 21.0 routes. The salary works out to 1.95 projected points per $1,000, 9th of 13 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Watson averaged 14.9 points with a simulated floor of 2.4 and a ceiling of 39.9, and he holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Green Bay is a 4.5-point favorite at home against Minnesota, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Chris Olave, NO vs CAR ($7,000)

Chris Olave projects 3rd at the position with 12.4 DraftKings points at $7,000. The model gives him 6.6 targets on 22.1 routes. The salary works out to 1.77 projected points per $1,000, 11th of 13 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Olave averaged 12.3 points with a simulated floor of 0.5 and a ceiling of 37.7, and he holds 11% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New Orleans is a 1.5-point favorite at home against Carolina, with an implied team total of 25 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Value: Josh Cameron, JAX at TEN ($3,300)

Josh Cameron projects for 10.0 DraftKings points at $3,300, which works out to 3.03 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 13 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 5.2 targets on 18.7 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Cameron averaged 9.8 points with a simulated floor of 2.1 and a ceiling of 25.1, and he holds 22% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Jacksonville is a 10.5-point favorite on the road against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 28.5 in a game totaled at 46.5.
